label: Solve the fixed-amount reception constraints on the two-bearer grounding profile (inference)
rule: Use the single eligible positive weight and zero own input at the recipient, and construct a fitting weight from the ratio of the fixed amounts
meaning: The actual graph, world, and two identities stay fixed while amounts range over positive assignments. Equal amounts are incompatible even on this rooted graph. A strict decrease suffices in the two-bearer profile. A general sole-supplier recipient satisfies the same necessary inequality.
